notes: Account: Axiom Security Labs — fintech platform for underwriting and payment risk scoring.
Primary ask: private VPC deployment with full BYOK/HSM integration and strict EU/NA residency controls.
Security lead: asked for architecture that 'never stores customer master keys in Redwood-managed KMS' — must support external HSM-backed keys and envelope encryption.
Preferred KMS: Azure Key Vault (HSM-backed) for EU workloads; AWS KMS BYOK for NA; GCP KMS optional for analytics cluster.
Key lifecycle requirements: customer-controlled key rotation, import/export for BYOK, documented key deletion process, and hardware-backed attestation (PKCS#11) for HSMs.
Audit & logging: need per-key usage logs forwarded to their SIEM (Splunk) with 1yr retention; request for signed, tamper-evident audit trail; integration with Redwood audit_logging feature mandatory.
Data residency: PII and transaction traces must remain in-region (EU for EMEA customers). Request explicit multi-region routing policy for model inference so that keys in EU never leave region.
Performance concern: security team flagged potential latency for HSM signing on token encryption path — wants test showing p95 impact under 100 qps.
Cost sensitivity: finance org wants ARR estimate vs cost delta for HSM (managed HSM pricing) vs Redwood-managed envelope keys.
Regulatory: preparing for SOC2 + ISO27001 audit; compliance team will request artifact pack and architecture diagrams.
Quote from CISO (call 2026-02-10): 'We will not accept private keys outside our control. Redwood must support hardware key material or bring-your-own-key flows.'

Initial PoC scope: 2-week POC with private control plane, Azure Key Vault HSM in eu-west, AWS KMS imported key in us-east, baseline benchmark (100 qps, 50ms p95 target), forward audit logs to Splunk test tenant.
Network: will require VPC peering and restricted egress rules; security asked for diagram with NAT/endpoint specifics and port list.
Legal: NDA signed (drive:/legal/AXM_ndas/nda_redwood_signed.pdf). Procurement will review standard BYOK Addendum before committing.
SE notes: propose envelope encryption + short-lived data keys cached in-memory on runtime; master key ops only for wrapping/unwrapping — reduces HSM calls.
Action items captured in meeting: generate KMS integration checklist; provide HSM perf report; produce drive diagram with key flow; open Jira ticket for egress whitelist.
PoC success criteria (customer): keys are controlled by Axiom, audit logs visible in their Splunk, latency within agreed SLOs, security review signoff.
